name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (NSMNY)
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year from the Maharashtra government, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer, as a top-up to PM-KISAN. Eligible farmer families thus receive Rs 12,000 per year in total (Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN + Rs 6,000 from NSMNY), i.e. Rs 4,000 combined per instalment cycle. Benefit is credited only to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts. (Government Resolution No. Kisani-2023/CR 42/11 A dated 15/06/2023.)
eligibility_rules: Must be a farmer family in Maharashtra (husband, wife and minor children) holding cultivable land as on 01.02.2019
Must be eligible for / a beneficiary of PM-KISAN Yojana - NSMNY beneficiaries are taken from the PM-KISAN beneficiary list provided by the Government of India
Bank account must be Aadhaar-linked and DBT-enabled to receive the benefit
exclusions: Farmer families where any member is a former or present holder of a constitutional post
Former or present Ministers/State Ministers, MPs (Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha), MLAs/MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, or Chairpersons of District Panchayats

All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government ministries, offices, departments and field units, Central or State PSEs, attached offices/autonomous institutions, and regular employees of local bodies (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
All superannuated/retired pensioners with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
All persons who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects registered with professional bodies and practicing
Amounts credited to ineligible persons are recovered as per the PM-KISAN SoP
how_to_apply: Self-register on the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or via CSC. The application is then verified and approved at Taluka Nodal Officer, District Nodal Officer and State Nodal Officer levels (district/state approval not needed if registered directly at TNO login). No separate NSMNY application - beneficiaries flow from the PM-KISAN list.
source_document: myScheme NSMNY page; Maharashtra GR No. Kisani-2023/CR 42/11 A dated 15/06/2023
